title: meta.sortBy in unified search response intentionally keeps the raw UI sort value, not the translated index field
answers: why is meta.sortBy still 'name_sort' instead of 'title'
results table column lookup for sort field
getColumns doesn't highlight the sorted column
body:
In public/app/features/search/service/unified.ts, `meta.sortBy` is set from the original (untranslated) `query.sort` value even though the actual API request now uses the mapped index field name from `toSortParam`. This is deliberate, per review discussion, not an oversight: it matches pre-existing behavior, and `getColumns` looks up the column by matching this name against fields already present in the response frame (e.g. `title`), so translating it could change which column gets treated as the sort column.
Do not "fix" this by passing the translated field into `meta.sortBy` without checking how `getColumns` consumes it.
applies: public/app/features/search/service/unified.ts - meta.sortBy assignment and consumers like getColumns
